sloka: तं दृष्ट्वा लोकनिन्द्या सा हीनरूपा प्रकामिता ।। ६.९५.७ ।।न्दर्पमिव रूपिणम्।कथं सर्वगुणैर्हीना गुणवन्तं महौजसम्।सुमुखं दुर्मुखी रामं कामयामास राक्षसी ।। ६.९५.८ ।।
transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā lokanindyā sā hīnarūpā prakāmitā ।। 6.95.7 ।।ndarpamiva rūpiṇam।kathaṁ sarvaguṇairhīnā guṇavantaṁ mahaujasam।sumukhaṁ durmukhī rāmaṁ kāmayāmāsa rākṣasī ।। 6.95.8 ।।

translations.english: "That woman of ugly appearance deserves to be killed. How is it that she was stung with love with that delicate Rama, a well wisher of all beings?"
